svg.title: Castaway: the theme, playing in a DOS text-mode module player
svg.desc: An 80 by 34 text screen from an invented module player, driftwood player, playing CASTAW~1.WAV, the project's synthesized 60-second lo-fi theme. Status lines give row, order, tempo 6, bpm 80, key F, -14 LUFS and the keys' filter; eight channel lines show keys, kalimba, bass, drums, hats, pad, vinyl and riser. CASTAWAY is drawn as an eight-band equaliser in green, cyan and blue, over the line: a ten-hour lo-fi island video, mostly, she nods; samples 0, recordings 0, nights 0, ships seen 0. Beside it, a framed thumbnail of the island: a palm, a raft, and her in headphones nodding on the beat; a ship crosses the horizon while she sips a coconut. Below, a two-band spectrum analyser and a scrolling pattern view of the real score.
